A '''mission''' was undertaken in [[132 ABY]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vurik]] to investigate rumors of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Dying Sun]]'', which dated back to the [[Jedi Civil War]].

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The mission was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]'', a guide written by [[Wizards of the Coast]].
